zh.name: ciaobjectives
zh.caption: CIA 三大目標與兩個相關觀念
zh.description: 上排三項是平行的安全目標；下排不可否認性是證據性質，明文是資料表示及暴露情境，兩者不是CIA的第四、第五要素。

items.title: C02 · Integrity
items.body:
完整性
內容可信嗎？

items.title: C03 · Availability
items.body:
可用性
需要時能用嗎？

items.title: C04 · Non-repudiation
items.body:
不可否認性
事後能查證誰做的嗎？

items.title: C05 · Cleartext
items.body:
明文
可讀資料是否暴露在不適當的信任邊界？

en.name: ciaobjectives
en.caption: CIA objectives and two related concepts
en.description: The three upper items are parallel security objectives. Non-repudiation concerns evidence; cleartext concerns data representation and exposure. They are not a fourth and fifth CIA objective.

items.title: C03 · Availability
items.body: Can authorized users use it when needed?

items.title: C05 · Cleartext
items.body: Is readable data exposed across an inappropriate trust boundary?

zh.name: transactiontampering
zh.caption: 交易完整性：金額遭未授權修改
zh.description: 左右是原始指示與被竄改內容的比較，並非兩筆已執行交易；金額從NT$10,000變成NT$100,000。

en.name: transactiontampering
en.caption: Transaction integrity: unauthorized amount change
en.description: The two states compare the original instruction with tampered content, not two executed transfers. The amount changes from NT$10,000 to NT$100,000.

zh.name: serviceavailability
zh.caption: 單點故障與多節點備援
zh.description: 上組：使用者連到故障的單一伺服器。下組：另一個使用者經流量分配，分別連到平行的A、B伺服器；A不轉送到B。分配器、資料層及共同故障仍須另行設計。

items.title: 單一伺服器故障
items.body: 單點故障可能造成中斷

en.name: serviceavailability
en.caption: Single points of failure and redundant nodes
en.description: Upper group: a user reaches one failed server. Lower group: another user reaches parallel servers A and B through traffic distribution; A does not forward to B. Distributor, data-layer and common-mode failures require separate design.

items.title: Single server fails
items.body: A single point of failure may interrupt service

zh.name: signatureevidence
zh.caption: Digital Signature：建立與驗證證據
zh.description: 典型概念流程；演算法的實際計算程序可能不同。身分歸屬須結合可信憑證、私鑰保護、時間及稽核證據，不能只靠資料庫中的名字。

items.title: 原始電子文件
items.body: 例如：已核准的製程變更單

items.title: 產生雜湊摘要（Hash）
items.body: 將文件映射成固定長度摘要

items.title: 使用私鑰進行數位簽章
items.body: 由簽署者控制的金鑰建立簽章

items.title: 驗證簽章與身分
items.body: 使用公鑰驗證，搭配憑證、時間與稽核資料

en.name: signatureevidence
en.caption: Digital signatures: creating and verifying evidence
en.description: A typical conceptual flow; actual computation differs by algorithm. Attribution also requires trusted certificates, private-key protection, time and audit evidence. A name in a database is insufficient.

items.title: Original electronic document
items.body: For example, an approved process-change record

items.title: Generate a cryptographic hash
items.body: Map the document to a fixed-length digest

items.title: Sign using the private key
items.body: Create a signature with a key controlled by the signer

items.title: Verify signature and identity
items.body: Use the public key with certificates, time and audit records

zh.name: transportprotection
zh.caption: HTTP 與 HTTPS：傳輸內容的保護
zh.description: 上排HTTP未額外加密時，截取流量者可能讀取內容。下排正確建立的HTTPS/TLS通道保護機密性與完整性；兩排是獨立比較，沒有HTTP轉成HTTPS的跨排連線。

items.title: 可讀取的內容
items.body: 未額外加密保護的傳輸

items.title: HTTP 伺服器
items.body: 第三方取得流量可能讀取內容

items.title: HTTPS 伺服器
items.body: 端點仍會處理已解密的內容

en.name: transportprotection
en.caption: HTTP and HTTPS: protecting data in transit
en.description: Upper row: HTTP without additional encryption may reveal content to an interceptor. Lower row: a correctly established HTTPS/TLS channel protects confidentiality and integrity. These are independent comparisons with no connection between the rows.

items.title: HTTP server
items.body: An interceptor may read captured content
